title: study
description: A study's spec (RFC-029, RFC-032 step 7): data/studies/<goal>/<study_id>.yaml, written once by a person or an agent (`evh study-run --spec`). Its id is `<goal>/<study_id>`; the spec names neither. The study's state is read from its log (<study_id>.events.jsonl), never stored apart. A study imported from a results.tsv (`evh study-import`) has a spec of `imported`, `source`, `measure`, `direction` and `note` only.

dataset.description: The validation dataset trials run on; a test set is refused.

system.description: The system the study starts from.

measure.description: The metric the study is decided on.

direction.description: Which way is better when the goal's own primary measure is not this one.

sampler.description: grid, agent, or a program speaking ask/tell over stdio.

accept.description: The rule a trial is kept by: `test` (separated as better than the best so far) or a point rule.

relative.description: The gain needed is a share of the best so far's.

margin.description: The goal's non-inferiority margin for a trial kept on its tie-break.

tie_break.description: What a trial no better is kept for, when it is non-inferior to the baseline.

limits.description: Metrics no trial may let fall beyond a limit, against the baseline.

stop.description: When the study stops: `trials`, or (to run until stopped) both `usd` and `wall_h`.

patience.description: Trials in a row without a kept one.

ask_timeout_h.description: How long an agent's ask stays open; default 2.

groups.description: The grid sampler's groups, tried in order a value at a time from the best so far.

move_on_after.description: Trials without a kept one that end the group.

prompts.description: The prompts an agent may change.

repeats.description: How often each trial's system runs; averaged per item.

show_items.description: How many of the best so far's weakest validation items a sampler is shown; default 5.

frozen.description: Files hashed with the spec: a change stops the study.

directions.description: The person's instructions to an agent sampler.

imported.description: Brought in from a past loop's results.tsv: closed, one number per trial, not confirmable.
